pattern: union two differently-headered tables, pivot, compute a difference, rank
question: rank centres by how much their turnout percentage dropped between the two years, worst first
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) , by_year AS (SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre) SELECT centre, avg_2023 - avg_2024 AS drop_pp FROM by_year ORDER BY drop_pp DESC, centre LIMIT 1
sql_duckdb: WITH attendance_2023 AS (SELECT Centre, "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolled_2023, "Avg Daily Present" AS avg_present_2023 FROM attendance_2023), attendance_2024 AS (SELECT centre_name AS Centre, enrolment AS enrolled_2024, average_attendance AS avg_present_2024 FROM attendance_2024), combined AS (SELECT a2023.Centre, a2023.avg_present_2023, a2024.avg_present_2024, a2023.enrolled_2023, a2024.enrolled_2024 FROM attendance_2023 AS a2023 JOIN attendance_2024 AS a2024 ON a2023.Centre = a2024.Centre WHERE NOT a2023.enrolled_2023 IS NULL AND NOT a2024.enrolled_2024 IS NULL) SELECT Centre, ((CAST(avg_present_2023 AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(NULLIF(enrolled_2023, 0), 0)) - (CAST(avg_present_2024 AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(NULLIF(enrolled_2024, 0), 0))) * 100 AS turnout_percentage_drop FROM combined ORDER BY turnout_percentage_drop DESC

CURRENT QUESTION:
rank centres by how much their turnout percentage dropped between the two years, worst first
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH attendance_2023 AS (
    SELECT
        Centre,
        "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolled_2023,
        "Avg Daily Present" AS avg_present_2023
    FROM attendance_2023
),
attendance_2024 AS (
    SELECT
        centre_name AS Centre,
        enrolment AS enrolled_2024,
        average_attendance AS avg_present_2024
    FROM attendance_2024
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        a2023.Centre,
        a2023.avg_present_2023,
        a2024.avg_present_2024,
        a2023.enrolled_2023,
        a2024.enrolled_2024
    FROM attendance_2023 a2023
    JOIN attendance_2024 a2024
        ON a2023.Centre = a2024.Centre
    WHERE a2023.enrolled_2023 IS NOT NULL
      AND a2024.enrolled_2024 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    Centre,
    ((avg_present_2023::DECIMAL / NULLIF(enrolled_2023, 0)) -
     (avg_present_2024::DECIMAL / NULLIF(enrolled_2024, 0))) * 100 AS turnout_percentage_drop
FROM combined
ORDER BY turnout_percentage_drop DESC;
```
